name: Symmetric paired InfoNCE
description: Symmetric image/text paired-batch cross-entropy, diagonal positives, optional valid-negative matrix; batch-size one is finite and zero.

parameters.mask: optional [N,N] valid candidate matrix retaining diagonal positives

examples.title: Train paired encoders with InfoNCE
examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root=tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
 ident=int(ctx.index)%4
 image=torch.zeros((1,16,16)); image[:,ident*4:(ident+1)*4,:]=1
 return {"image":synth.Image(image),"text":f"shape {ident}"}
ds=synth.Spec("info-nce-pairs",generator=samples,size=24,splits={"train":0.75,"val":0.25},seed=11,root=root,monitor="none").run()
train=ds.for_recipe("contrastive-pairs",split="train",tokenizer="char",max_len=16)
val=ds.for_recipe("contrastive-pairs",split="val",like=train,tokenizer="char",max_len=16)
model=build("image-text-dual-encoder","tiny",vocab_size=64,context_length=16,embedding_dim=8,in_channels=1,width=4,text_width=8,text_heads=2,text_layers=1)
trainer=Trainer(model,train,val,recipe="contrastive-pairs",recipe_config={"loss":"info-nce","temperature":0.07},max_epochs=1,batch_size=4,device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
result=trainer.evaluate(val)
